title: OpenBao runtime and storage
description: OpenBao runtime and storage. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. See the profile validation record for tested environments and native alert coverage.

options.query:
| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_barrier_delete_*")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_barrier_delete_sum" OR metric_name="vault_barrier_delete_count"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_barrier_delete_sum","barrier_delete",metric_name="vault_barrier_delete_count","barrier_delete") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_sum$"),value,null()))) AS total sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_count$"),value,null()))) AS observations BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| where observations>0
| eval value=total/observations
| eval _time=bucket_time
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f
